title: Design System: Dr. Fernando Topanotti Tarabay

display.purpose: The doctor's name in the opening screen only.

title.purpose: Group headings, area titles, article card titles.

lead.purpose: Section intros and the about summary.

body.purpose: Running text; 18px/1.7 inside the article reader.

label.purpose: Dates, counts, the wordmark's role line (14px). Sentence case.

title-xl.purpose: Newest article in the index, featured interview, menu sheet links.

title-lg.purpose: Timeline years, article sub-heads, footer name.

title-sm.purpose: Area titles, article rows, article sub-sub-heads.

body-lg.purpose: Article reader text; training and role titles at 500.

small.purpose: Meta lines, interview descriptions, credential nodes on phones.

shadows.name: node-lit
shadows.purpose: Ring around a lit node (hover, focus, open, current). The only glow in the system.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Press feedback (160ms), underline edges (260ms), area panels (280ms), menu (260ms).

motion.name: hero-entrance
motion.value: mesh edges draw 1500ms; credential nodes light in sequence from 560ms, 150ms apart
motion.purpose: The one authored moment, on load only; absent under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled button: every booking action on WhatsApp.
components.html: Agendar pelo WhatsApp
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1.5px solid #096bad; border-radius: 10px; background: #096bad; color: #fff; font: 500 17px/1.2 'Fira Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #144487; border-color: #144487; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #096bad; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action beside the primary (e.g. 'Ver áreas de atuação').
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1.5px solid #b9c8d6; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #144487; font: 500 17px/1.2 'Fira Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #e7f0f8; border-color: #096bad; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #096bad; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Node List
components.description: Signature: items hang on one azure edge, each marked by a ring that lights on hover or focus.
components.html:
1. Coordenador da Unidade do AVC do Hospital São José
  2. Sócio-fundador e diretor técnico da Aura Neurologia
  3. Preceptor da Residência Médica em Neurologia
components.css: .ds-nodes { position: relative; display: grid; gap: 16px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font: 500 16px/1.4 'Fira Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nodes::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 5.25px; top: 17px; bottom: 17px; width: 1.5px; background: #096bad; } .ds-nodes a { display: flex; gap: 14px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 6px 0; color: #12305c; text-decoration: none; } .ds-node { position: relative; flex: none; width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-top: 5px; border: 2px solid #096bad; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; transition: background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-nodes a:hover .ds-node, .ds-nodes a:focus-visible .ds-node { background: #096bad; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(9 107 173 / 0.18); } .ds-nodes a:hover { color: #096bad; }

components.name: Article Row
components.description: Editorial index row on the azure edge; the whole row opens the in-page reader.
components.html:
1. 10 de abril de 2024 · 2 min de leituraPrevenção do AVC: Hábitos Saudáveis que Salvam VidasDescubra como pequenas mudanças no seu dia a dia podem reduzir significativamente o risco de um Acidente Vascular Cerebral.
  2. 3 de abril de 2024 · 2 min de leituraInsônia: Quando a Noite Vira Um ProblemaProblemas para dormir? Entenda as causas da insônia e as estratégias para recuperar seu sono e bem-estar.
components.css: .ds-index { max-width: 420px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border-top: 1px solid #b9c8d6; font-family: 'Fira Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-index li { position: relative; } .ds-index li:not(:last-child)::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 5.5px; top: 33px; bottom: -33px; width: 1px; background: rgb(9 107 173 / 0.38); } .ds-index a { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 12px 1fr; column-gap: 16px; padding: 24px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #d8e1ea; color: #3a464e; text-decoration: none; } .ds-node { position: relative; z-index: 1; width: 12px; height: 12px; margin-top: 3px; border: 2px solid #096bad; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; transition: background-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-body { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-meta { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #5a6872; } .ds-title { font: 600 22px/1.08 'Fira Sans Extra Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; color: #12305c; } .ds-desc { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; overflow: hidden; } .ds-index a:hover .ds-node, .ds-index a:focus-visible .ds-node { background: #096bad; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(9 107 173 / 0.18); } .ds-index a:hover .ds-title { color: #096bad; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Contact form field with a visible label; errors show under the field on submit.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 360px; font: 500 15px 'Fira Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #12305c; } .ds-field input { min-height: 52px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #b9c8d6; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #12305c; font: 400 17px/1.4 'Fira Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #096bad; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(9 107 173 / 0.22); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Desktop section link; the current section gains an azure underline edge.
components.html: ÁreasSobreFormaçãoMídia
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; font: 500 16px 'Fira Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; color: #445159; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms ease; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 6px; height: 1.5px; background: #096bad; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='location'] { color: #12305c; } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current='location']::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

narrative.overview:
The Aura Neurologia brain is a triangulated mesh, and this system treats that mesh as wiring, not wallpaper. Every credential, area of practice, dated qualification and section is a node; thin azure edges connect the nodes in lists, timelines and the menu, and the edges lead the eye toward one action, booking on WhatsApp. The mesh itself appears as a faint field only behind the doctor's portrait in the opening screen.

The surface is calm, white and exact: real studio photographs of Dr. Fernando, navy condensed headlines, slate body text at a generous size for older readers, and a single signal colour. Sections alternate white and ice-blue grounds, with one deep navy band, for the interviews only. The old site's rounded, playful, multi-coloured cards are the confirmed anti-reference.
keyCharacteristics: One signal colour (Aura azure) for edges, nodes, links and the single filled button style.
Nodes and edges as the list grammar: 12px azure rings joined by 1px azure lines.
Condensed display type (Fira Sans Extra Condensed 600) over a humanist text face (Fira Sans).
Flat surfaces; depth only from ground changes, hairlines and photographs.
Phone first: every pattern is designed at 360–430px and grows.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Azure is the only saturated colour on the page. It marks what is connected or actionable; nothing decorative is azure except the mesh field behind the portrait.

rules.name: The Brand-Exact Rule
rules.body: Azure #096bad, navy #144487 and slate #445159 come from the Aura identity manual and are never shifted, tinted toward violet or replaced.

rules.name: The Readable Patient Rule
rules.body: Text people read is 16px or larger (17px body on phones); nothing is smaller than 13px. Many readers are older patients or worried relatives.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Display at 600 only; text at 400 and 500 only. No bold-and-big.

rules.name: The Light Is the State Rule
rules.body: Hover, focus and the current section fill the node with azure and raise its edge to full strength. Nothing lifts with a shadow.

dos: Do keep azure (#096bad) as the only signal colour and use it for every booking action.
Do keep the deep navy band to one section (the interviews); every other ground is white or ice.
Do show CRM/SC 22270 and RQE 18727 beside the doctor's name wherever the name is presented as a credential.
Do use real photographs of Dr. Fernando, his team and his clinic.
Do build new lists on the node-and-edge grammar (12px ring, 1px azure edge).
Do gate hover styles behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and give every tappable element a pressed state.
donts: Don't use stock or AI-generated illustrations; the article images of the old site were dropped for that reason.
Don't add drop shadows, gradients over photographs or glass effects.
Don't set text people read below 16px or labels below 13px.
Don't return to the old site's look: Poppins, tabs that hide sections, a splash screen, rounded multi-coloured icon cards.
Don't recolour, outline or distort the Aura brain symbol.
